blocks.title: National Fellowship for OBC Students (NF-OBC)
blocks.summary: To provide financial assistance to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) to pursue regular and full-time higher studies leading to M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees in Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Engineering/Technology.

rows: 1,000 annual research slots for OBC M.Phil/Ph.D. scholars.
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Central Sector component under SHREYAS umbrella (₹4,103.55 Cr total SHREYAS allocation).
National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC) / UGC.

items: **Target Beneficiaries:** OBC research scholars who have qualified UGC-NET / CSIR-NET-JRF and registered in recognized Indian universities (including 5% horizontal reservation for Persons with Disabilities).

**Eligibility Criteria:** Candidate must belong to OBC category (Non-Creamy Layer) with annual family income below ₹8.00 Lakh per annum and registered in regular M.Phil./Ph.D. programs. 5% slots are horizontally reserved for PwD candidates.
Slots: 1,000 slots per year (increased from historical 300 slots).
Horizontal Reservation: 5% of total fellowship slots are horizontally reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) belonging to OBC category.
Fellowship Rates: Equivalent to UGC Fellowship rates (JRF: ₹37,000/month for first 2 years; SRF: ₹42,000/month for remaining 3 years).
Tenure: Maximum 5 years (M.Phil: 2 years; Ph.D.: 5 years; M.Phil + Ph.D.: 5 years).
Slots: 1,000 slots per year (do not write obsolete 300 slots).
Horizontal Reservation: 5% slots for Persons with Disabilities (PwD).
Fellowship Rates: Updated to ₹37,000/mo (JRF) and ₹42,000/mo (SRF) as per revised UGC scales.
